{"path":"neuron_growth_zai-glm-5.3_01.html","edit_description":"Create a new single self-contained HTML file: a neon "growing neuron network" canvas simulation. Full spec:

OVERALL
- One 800x800 <canvas id="c"> centered on a dark page using flexbox; page background #05070f.
- Only external library allowed: dat.gui loaded from CDN (https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/dat-gui/0.7.9/dat.gui.min.js). No other libraries, frameworks, modules, assets, images, textures.
- All CSS and vanilla JavaScript inline in this one file.
- Futuristic, high-contrast, glowing, slightly gritty look using canvas shadowBlur for neon glow.
- Do NOT mention any game, movie, brand, or copyrighted visual style anywhere in code or comments.

EXACT PALETTE (use these constants in a JS palette object and as dat.gui defaults):
- background: #05070f
- background glow: #101a3a
- main branch: #00e5ff
- secondary/accent branch: #d6ff00
- synapse: #ff2bd6
- pulse: #fff36a
- UI/accent: #ffd400
- grid/scanline: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.08)

CODE STRUCTURE — keep simple and compact, with short comments marking these major sections:
1. setup (canvas, context, resize-safe, params object)
2. GUI setup (dat.gui)
3. neuron growth
4. synapse detection
5. pulse animation
6. rendering
7. main loop (requestAnimationFrame)

PARAMS object (bound to dat.gui) must include:
Growth folder: neuronCount (3-6, default 4... actually allow range 3-6, default 4 or 5), branchGrowthSpeed (0.5-5, default ~2), maxBranchDepth (3-9, default 6), branchSplitChance (0-1, default ~0.25), branchCurvature (0-1, default ~0.4), maxBranchLength (60-300 px, default ~150), maxBranchCount (hidden cap ~260 for performance).
Synapses folder: synapseDistance (10-80 px, default ~28), synapseGlow (2-30, default ~10).
Pulses folder: pulseSpeed (0.1-3, default ~1), pulseFrequency (0.1-5 sparks/sec, default ~1.5), pulseBrightness (0.2-3, default ~1).
Visuals folder: backgroundColor (color, #05070f), glowColor (background glow #101a3a), branchColor (#00e5ff), accentColor (#d6ff00), synapseColor (#ff2bd6), pulseColor (#fff36a), plus toggles: showScanlines (true), showVignette (true).
Also expose UI/accent #ffd400 somewhere sensible (e.g. used for neuron somas / headers).
Buttons (top-level or in a folder): "regenerate network", "clear canvas", "pause/resume animation". Changing neuronCount or growth params triggers regenerate (onFinishChange).

SIMULATION — neuron growth:
- On regenerate: clear arrays; create params.neuronCount (3-6, randomized within clamp) seed neurons at random positions near canvas center (within ~25% of center), each with a soma (glowing dot radius ~4-7) and a start angle.
- Each neuron grows 3-5 initial dendrites/axons recursively as Branch objects: {x, y, angle, depth, len (grown so far), targetLen randomized around maxBranchLength scaled by depth, thickness randomized 0.5-2.2 and thinner with depth, speed from branchGrowthSpeed, accent: boolean (some branches use accent color), curve drift}.
- Animated step-by-step growth: each frame every active branch extends by speed px along its angle; angle drifts smoothly by noise-ish random walk scaled by branchCurvature → positions form organic quadratic-curve-like paths (store segments as arrays of points; draw with quadraticCurveTo through midpoints).
- While growing, with branchSplitChance per step (only if depth < maxBranchDepth and totalBranchCount < cap): spawn a side branch at a divergent angle (+/- 25-70 deg), thinner, shorter, mark some as accent color.
- Branch stops when reaching targetLen; tip becomes eligible for synapse detection. Hard caps: maxBranchDepth, maxBranchCount (~260), branches stop outside canvas margins.
- Growth ends (stable) when no active branches remain.

SYNAPSES:
- Each frame during/after growth, check branch tips (and somas) pairwise within synapseDistance; when close, create a synapse {ax, ay, bx, by, phase, strength} linking the two branch tips. Prevent duplicates: skip if either tip already connected to the other (track a Set of "idA|idB" keys, each tip has an id; a tip can have at most ~2 synapses).
- Synapses render as glowing magenta (#ff2bd6) diamonds/bursts at the midpoint, glow pulsing over time via sin(time*2 + phase), brighter than branches; synapseGlow controls shadowBlur.
- Draw a faint connecting line between the two tips.

PULSES:
- Pulses travel along synapse links (from tip A to tip B): {synapse, t 0..1, dir}. Advance t by pulseSpeed * dt; interpolate position smoothly (lerp with slight eased curve). Spawn randomly: if active pulses < cap (e.g. 24) spawn at rate pulseFrequency per second on a random synapse, random direction.
- Render as bright #fff36a sparks: small core dot + short trailing streak along movement direction, shadowBlur glow scaled by pulseBrightness; when arriving, briefly flash the target tip / trigger a refractory glow.
- After growth completes, pulses keep firing forever to keep the scene alive; randomly activate different synapses.

RENDERING (every frame):
- Clear with backgroundColor; paint soft radial background glow (#101a3a) from center using a cached radial gradient.
- Faint grid or scanlines in rgba(0,229,255,0.08): draw scanlines as 1px horizontal lines every 3-4 px (cache to offscreen canvas once), optionally subtle flicker.
- Draw all branch segments: batch by color — main branches stroke #00e5ff thin (0.5-2.2 px) with shadowBlur ~6; accent branches #d6ff00. Use quadraticCurveTo through segment midpoints for smooth organic curves. Do not shadow every segment individually if slow — set shadow once per batch.
- Draw neuron somas: #ffd400 glowing cores with halo.
- Draw synapses (brighter, magenta, pulsing glow).
- Draw pulses (brightest sparks with trails).
- Vignette: cached radial gradient overlay, transparent center to rgba(0,0,0,0.55) edges.
- requestAnimationFrame main loop; dt-based animation; pause/resume flag; clear canvas button wipes to background; regenerate rebuilds network.
- Keep it lightweight: plain arrays/objects, cached gradients/scanline layer, no per-pixel ops, no heavy physics.

Also add a small HTML title (e.g. "Neon Neural Growth") and a subtle hint line under/beside canvas in UI accent color is optional. Make sure dat.gui panel sits top-right. Ensure the file runs offline except the dat.gui CDN. Total length roughly 450-650 lines, clean readable code with section comments."}
